system.name: VY Canis Majoris
system.description: One of the largest and most luminous red hypergiants in the Milky Way, located 3,900 light-years away in Canis Major. If placed at the centre of the Solar System it would engulf Jupiter's orbit. It is surrounded by a complex nebula of ejected material and is expected to explode as a hypernova.

vycma.name: VY Canis Majoris
vycma.description: An extreme M5e red hypergiant with a diameter roughly 1,420 times the Sun's — one of the largest stars known. Its surface pulsates irregularly, and it loses mass at catastrophic rates through asymmetric eruptions that have built up a complex surrounding nebula. It will end its life in a hypernova or direct collapse.
vycma.funFact: VY Canis Majoris is so large that light takes over six hours to travel from one side to the other — yet it fits inside a single pixel at the scale of the Solar System diagram.
